name: Flicker
summary: Spinner library of flip-dot display loaders, with a builder that exports them to SVG, React or Flutter.
description: A loading spinner library inspired by flip-dot displays (version 1.5). Browse the spinner collection or open the create tool, which takes a 5x5 or 7x7 dot grid, on and off colors and a pixel size, and exports to SVG, React or Flutter. The gallery grid itself is rendered by JavaScript, so the individual presets could not be read.
